scope: 21 static weapon art assets; offline source and export validation

checks: Seven categories with three distinct concept IDs each
Source and all FBX LOD meshes closed, finite and positive-area
Independent GLB indices, positions, normals, UVs and vertex pigments
Three decreasing FBX LODs and no more than five surface materials
Export +Y up, metre dimensions, zero grip pivot and attachment markers
Source-to-export vertex positions and immutable SHA-256 records

artReview.note: Geometry checks do not judge fidelity to the approved concept sheets. Review the 21 preview images and actual Unity rendering separately.

unityValidation.note: Unity import, materials, prefabs and runtime remain outside this offline check. No Unity validation is claimed here.

coincidentPositionEdgeDiagnostics.note: Diagnostic only: attribute seams and coincident closed shells share positions. Indexed manifold checks use Blender and FBX.

fbx.method: Fresh Blender FBX import for every asset
